name: chat-filters
description: Two chat sources for the lists a filter on a chat or a person reads. WhatsApp runs the real provider over a fake corpus: a one-to-one chat, a group with a member who never speaks, and a group with a member known only by a LID. iMessage is the fixture twin: the same three shapes, with who is in each chat stated in chats.json. The test adds a member to a group between syncs.
